title: Stratamize Statement Audit Model
description: A processor-neutral contract for normalizing statement-level merchant processing totals without cardholder or bank-account data. Cross-field accounting and privacy rules are enforced by tools/validate_audit.py.

calculation_basis.description: Declares the numerator and denominator convention used by this release.

start.description: First calendar date covered by the statement, inclusive.

end.description: Last calendar date covered by the statement, inclusive.

currency.description: All monetary fields use US dollars. Mixed-currency records are invalid.

card_volume.description: Gross settled purchase volume for the statement period, before refunds, chargebacks, or funding adjustments.

transaction_count.description: Count of settled purchase transactions included in card_volume.

gross_processing_fees.description: Gross processing-related charges before statement_credits; equals the sum of fee_groups.

statement_credits.description: Processing-fee credits or rebates applied on the statement. Transaction refunds and funding adjustments are excluded.

total_processing_fees.description: Net processing fees: gross_processing_fees minus statement_credits.

effective_rate.description: total_processing_fees divided by card_volume, expressed as a decimal rounded to six places; null when card_volume is zero.

average_ticket.description: card_volume divided by transaction_count, rounded to cents; null when transaction_count is zero.

pricing_model.description: Observed statement pricing presentation, not a legal or qualification determination.

fee_groups.description: Gross, nonnegative processing charges grouped once by category. Categories must be unique.

review_notes.description: Optional audit explanations only. Never include merchant identity, card data, bank data, credentials, or secrets.

money.description: A nonnegative USD amount with no more than two decimal places. Decimal precision is enforced by the companion validator.

rate.description: A nonnegative decimal rate with no more than six decimal places.
